title: jacquemontia tomentella

It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Jacquemontia tomentella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
